prompt: An agent lifecycle hook captures a transcript to disk, building the destination path from a hook-supplied session identifier and writing the file before that identifier is ever validated. A crafted identifier containing path-traversal segments can therefore write the captured transcript outside the intended cache directory. Add a guard so an unsafe identifier cannot escape the cache directory, preserving the existing "nothing captured" signal. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: hook payload writing files outside cache directory
where session identifiers are validated before use
_subject: fix: validate session ID in Pi captureTranscript before writing
